verdicts.explanation: The introduction gives 1.8 × 10−6 S/cm at 40 °C for the LISICON with composition Li4−xGe1−xPxO4 (x = 0.67), citing Ref. [123], so the value, temperature, material and literature_cited origin are all correct, and the secondary fields are null as the paper does not state them.

The conclusions give σ = 1.2×10−2 S/cm at room temperature for tetragonal Li10GeP2S12 citing Ref. [78], which is a literature value; the null numeric temperature is correct since no numeric temperature is given.

The introduction states that the tetragonal x = 0.67 phase named LGPS, discovered in Ref. [78], has a record conductivity of 12 × 10−3 S/cm, with no temperature given, so the null temperature and literature_cited origin are correct.

The conclusions describe the monoclinic/quasi-orthorhombic thio-LISICON (o-LGPS) as having σ ∼ 10−3 S/cm at room temperature, citing Ref. [75]; the value is approximate, the origin is literature_cited, and the temperature is room temperature with a null numeric value, all consistent with the paper.
